title: Keep read requests in the plan and drain queue; plan reads fit budget
summary: `athena plan` reads unread requests, which makes them Proposed, and the queue view (steward::queued_work plus approved_work) then drops them, so plan and drain see nothing open. Fix the queue so a drained-channel job that was read and has a runnable reading stays in the plan and the drain queue as a read item, and make planning reads need only the reader cap (not reader+job caps), so the default $2 budget reads. Audience: the operator running `athena plan` then `athena drain`.

defaults_applied.how: New tests for both defects; cargo test and clippy must pass.
Fix the queue view's state filter and the plan budget gate, not just the 25 stuck requests.
Criteria check plan then plan/drain still seeing the request, not that functions exist.
Behavior verified by running cargo test.
One focused change to queue listing and plan budget gate.
Doc comments and README updated for an outside reader.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Root cause 1: RealSteps::queue (crates/athena-cli/src/drain.rs ~1228) lists only approved_work (steward-approved proposals) and queued_work (JobState::Queued, drained channels); a request read by the planning pass becomes JobState::Proposed and matches neither.

Fix 1: add a steward function (e.g. read_work) listing JobState::Proposed jobs on DRAINED_CHANNELS whose latest reading has a capability, and queue them as read=true items with plan entries, deduplicated against approved_work. Declined jobs, readings without capability, and jobs the user has already closed stay out.

Root cause 2: Drain::prepare requires budget.fits(caps.read + caps.run) (reader_usd 0.50 + job_usd 8.00 = 8.50 in athena.toml), which exceeds the default --budget 2, so nothing is read. Planning never runs the job, so in plan mode it should require only caps.read (drain keeps its own run check).
A read item whose plan is still incomplete after its reading remains in the plan and is flagged for correction (existing note), not dropped.

The nit about the misleading test name in drain.rs tests and the default-budget read-only wording from job 614b are not required; only the two reported defects are fixed. Docs/README/CHANGELOG are updated where they say read requests leave the queue.

acceptance_criteria.text: A test using stub steps and a real-records fixture shows: queue a vague request, run plan with a budget that allows reading, then a second `plan` (and the drain's queue view) still lists that request, now as read, instead of 'nothing is open'. Run: cargo test -p athena-cli.

A test shows plan at the default budget 2 with reader_usd 0.50 and job_usd 8.00 reads an underspecified unread request (no 'no room in the job limit or the budget' note), while drain still requires reader+job room before starting a job. Run: cargo test -p athena-cli.
A test shows drain works a request that plan already read: it runs it without a second reading and counts it as read=true. Run: cargo test.
Declined jobs, jobs with no capability reading, and closed jobs are not listed in the queue; a unit test in athena-core steward covers the new listing function. Run: cargo test -p athena-core.
cargo clippy --all-targets is clean and cargo fmt --check passes.
README/help text for `athena plan` and the drain doc comment no longer say that a read request leaves the queue; CHANGELOG notes the fix.

out_of_scope: Migrating or re-queuing the 25 already-proposed requests by hand (the new listing picks them up if they have a runnable reading).
Renaming the misleading test from the earlier verification nit.
departures: Slightly higher cost and lower pass rate than reference: the change spans core and CLI queue logic and needs new tests with stub steps.
